therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: antibody-drug conjugate targeting BCMA combined with PD-1 checkpoint inhibition
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: direct myeloma cell killing via BCMA targeting plus T-cell activation via PD-1 blockade

results.effect_size: ORR 43% (95% CI: 24.5–62.8) in Part 2 expansion cohort
results.target_engagement_evidence: PK data showed measurable drug concentrations with geometric mean Cmax of 46.70 ug/mL for total mAb in Part 2
subgroup_findings: Part 1 dose escalation: ORR 67% at 2.5 mg/kg dose, 43% at 3.4 mg/kg dose
results.dose_information: belantamab mafodotin 2.5 mg/kg IV every 3 weeks + pembrolizumab 200 mg IV every 3 weeks
